こうしてステラにもてなしてもらうのは、不思議な感じがするな。: Having Stella serve us like this feels pretty strange.
ふふっ、そうね。\nでも、それも含めてなんだか楽しいわ。: Fufu, it does. But including that, it's somehow quite fun.
ここでの生活を楽しんでくれているようで何よりだ。\nしかし、申し訳ない。忙しそう: I'm just glad you seem to be enjoying your time here. Still, I apologize for coming over when you all seem so busy...
私はいつも通りお屋敷のお仕事をさせてもらってるだけだから\n問題はないわ。: I'm just helping out with mansion work as usual, so it's no trouble at all.
カークランドさんたちは見ての通りだけど……: As for Kirkland-san and the others, well, as you can see...
それじゃ、お嬢の午後のスケジュールを確認するぞ。\n――まずは生徒会との連絡会議: Alright, let's go over Milady's afternoon schedule. —First, a liaison meeting with the student council.
その後、施設管理課との打ち合わせ、\n最後に貴族制廃止に関するシンポジウムへの出: After that, a meeting with the Facility Management Division, and finally, attending a symposium regarding the abolition of the aristocracy.
あの、リュシー様。ドロテア様の時間は有限ですよ。\n廃止が決定しているのに、粘る: Um, Lucy-sama. Dorothea-sama's time is limited. Since the abolition has already been decided, is there really a need to entertain people who are just clinging on...?
そ、そうですね……ドロテア様がシンポジウムに出席する必要は、\n特に無い気がしま: Y-Yes, indeed... I feel like there's no particular need for Dorothea-sama to attend the symposium...
あたしはそのシンポジウムっていうのはわかんないけど……\nまあ、ドロテアは働きす: I don't really get what this whole symposium thing is about... but yeah, feels like Dorothea is working herself way too hard.
……まあ、気持ちはわからなくはない。\nだけど、メイドとしては領分を超えた発言だ: ...Well, I don't fail to understand how you feel. But as maids, those comments go beyond your place.
みんな、心配してくれてありがとう。: Everyone, thank you for worrying about me.
でも……たとえ全員が納得できなくても、\n可能な限り貴族の方々の不安を取り除きた: However... even if we cannot get every single person to agree, I want to relieve the anxieties of the nobility as much as possible.
聞き耳立てるのは悪いと思うんだが……\nどこにでもあるんだな、貴族と平民の問題っ: I know it's rude to eavesdrop... but I guess issues between nobles and commoners exist everywhere.
ああ。ドロテアは貴族と平民の融和を目指しているが、\nやはりなかなか大変な道では: Yeah. Dorothea is aiming for the reconciliation of nobles and commoners, but it seems to be quite a difficult path after all...
何かしら？\nあ、お茶のお代わり？: Yes? Ah, would you like a refill on your tea?
あ、ああ……いや……\nじゃあ、いただこうかな。: A-Ah... no... Well, maybe I will.
あれ？\nリュシー様、そういえばノヴァセレスの定例会は？: Huh? Lucy-sama, speaking of which, what about the regular Novaceres meeting?
えっ！？ でも、今日に変更になったって連絡された気が……: Eh!? But I thought I was notified that it was rescheduled for today...
……おい？ ミリアム？ それ、あたしも聞いた話か？: ...Hey? Miriam? Is that something I was supposed to know about too?
……あああああああ！？ ご、ごめんなさーい！\nそういえば、役員の人に伝えてって: ...Aaaaaahhh!? I-I'm so sorry! Come to think of it, an officer asked me to pass that along and I completely forgot!
……お前なぁ。報告と連絡と相談。\nこれはしっかりとやれっていつも言ってるだろ！: ...You knucklehead. Report, communicate, consult. I always tell you to make sure you do those properly!
……はぁ、どうして役員の人はミリィにお願いをするんでしょうね。: ...Haa, I wonder why the officer would ask Milly of all people to pass a message.
あたしたちの中で、ミリアムが一番声をかけやすいからだろうな。\n……まあ、こんな: Probably because Miriam is the easiest to talk to among us. ...Though I doubt they expected her to make a blunder like this.
まあ、お嬢が出なくても定例会は連絡をするだけだ。\nあたしが代理出席でも問題はな: Well, even if Milady doesn't attend, the regular meeting is just for passing information. There's no problem if I attend as a proxy, but...
そうすると、護衛がいなくなるのが問題だ。\n貴族制廃止に反対しているやつは少なか: If I do that, the problem is that she'll be left without a guard. There are more than a few people opposed to the abolition of the aristocracy.
貴族と平民の融和の象徴『アークトゥルス』、\nそのリーダーのお嬢を狙うものがいな: As the leader of Arcturus, the symbol of noble and commoner reconciliation, we can't rule out the possibility of someone targeting Milady.
……ミリアム、本当に分かってるのか？ やることは多い。\n会場の導線確認、不審者: ...Miriam, do you really understand? There's a lot to do. Checking the venue's flow of movement, watching for suspicious individuals, securing evacuation routes in an emergency...
それだけじゃない。シンポジウム中は秘書としても立ち回る。\nお嬢を守るだけじゃな: That's not all. During the symposium, you'd also have to act as a secretary. It's not just about guarding Milady... Even so, can you guys handle it?
さ、流石にそれは……: Th-That's a bit too much for us...
うう……わたしたちだけだと不安です……: Uugh... Just the two of us makes me nervous...
で、でも！ やれるかどうかじゃないよ！\n他に任せられる人が居ないなら、ボクたち: B-But! It's not about whether we can or can't! If there's no one else to rely on, we have to do it...
ね、ムーアクロフトさん、\nよければその役目、私に任せてくれないかしら？: Say, Moorcroft-san, if it's alright with you, would you mind entrusting that role to me?
身のこなしから大体予想はついているが……\n生身で戦えるんだよな？: I can guess well enough from your movement and bearing... but you can fight unarmed, right?
ええ。\n一般人に後れを取ることはないわ。: Yes. I won't lose to any ordinary person.
……そうだな。ここは申し訳ないがお願いをしてもいいか？\nお前の能力と人柄なら安: ...I see. In that case, sorry to burden you, but may I ask you to handle it? With your skill and character, I can leave it in your hands with peace of mind.
……うぐぐ、確かに……悔しいけど、\nブレーメルさんに任せるのであれば、異論はな: ...Ugh, it's frustrating, but... if it's leaving it to Bremer-san, I have no objections...
ええ、任せて。\nあなたたちの大切なご主人様はしっかりとお守りするわ。: Yes, leave it to me. I will firmly protect your precious master.
なあ、リュシーの方はどうだ？\nいるなら、あたしが護衛してやってもいいぞ？: Hey, what about Lucy's side? If you need one, I could guard you.
いや、さっきも言ったがこっちはただの連絡会だからな。\nあたしの方は気にしなくて: No, as I said earlier, mine is just a liaison meeting. You don't need to worry about me.
そっか。じゃあ、あたしは屋敷でミリアムたちの面倒見とくよ。: I see. Then I'll stay at the mansion and look after Miriam and the others.
……なんでマナンダルさんが面倒を見るんですか。\nリュシー様も言ってやってくださ: ...Why is Manandhar-san looking after us? Lucy-sama, please tell her off too.
ああ、よろしく頼むな。: Ah, I'll count on you then.
ふふっ……ではブレーメルさん、\nご迷惑をおかけしますがよろしくお願いしますね。: Fufu... Well then, Bremer-san, I apologize for the trouble, but I'll be in your care.
いいえ、大丈夫よ。\n……私の方こそ、よろしくね。: No, it's quite alright. ...I'll be in your care as well.
カークランド家が率先して制度を壊すなど、裏切り行為ではないか！: For the Kirkland family to take the lead in dismantling the system, isn't that an act of betrayal!
我々の生活はどうなる！\n何の保障もないまま放り出すつもりか！: What will become of our lives! Are you intending to throw us out with no guarantees whatsoever!
廃止後も、極端に生活が毀損されることのないよう、\n行政側と調整を進めています。: Even after the abolition, we are coordinating with the administration to ensure your lives aren't drastically impaired. Specifically—
そんな口約束を誰が信じるんだ！: Who could possibly believe a verbal promise like that!
（一生懸命説明しているカークランドさんの話なんて、\n誰もまともに聞いてはいない: (No one is even properly listening to Kirkland-san, despite how hard she's trying to explain...)
（反対派の貴族たちしか参加せず、その貴族たちから罵声を\n一身に浴びせられる……: (Only the opposing nobles showed up, and she's taking all their verbal abuse completely alone... You wouldn't normally call this a symposium.)
（……まあ、当然だとも思う。権力に溺れた者たちが、\nそう簡単に手放すはずがない: (...Well, I suppose that's only natural. Those drunk on power would never let go of it so easily.)
（そして、そんな相手に……主張を取り合わない相手に、\n話を聞かせる一番簡単な方: (And the easiest way to make someone like that listen... someone who refuses to hear you out... is—)
お前のような小娘に……我々貴族の歴史が、思いが……何が分かるッ！\nその身に思い: A little girl like you... what could you possibly understand of our noble history and feelings! I'll teach your body a lesson!!
なっ……き、貴様、いつの間に……っ！\n私に触れるな！ 放せっ、放せぇぇ！！: Wha... Y-You, when did you...! Don't touch me! Let go, let me gooo!!
大人しくして。\n……これ以上、乱暴なことはしたくないわ。: Be quiet. ...I don't want to resort to any further violence.
ええ、わたくしは問題ありません。\nブレーメルさんが迅速にご対応くださいましたか: Yes, I am fine. Because Bremer-san handled it so swiftly.
皆様、お騒がせして申し訳ありません。\nですが……: Everyone, I apologize for the disruption. However...
わたくしは皆様にご納得いただくまで、何度でも説明の場を設けます。\nですので、ど: I will hold explanatory sessions as many times as necessary until you are all satisfied. So, I humbly ask for your cooperation.
お疲れ様。どうぞ、お茶です。: Good work out there. Here, please have some tea.
ムーアクロフトさんが淹れてくれたものを預かっていました。: I was holding onto this, which Moorcroft-san brewed for you.
ありがとうございます……ん……\nリュシーの淹れたお茶は、いつでも美味しいですね: Thank you very much... Mm... Lucy's tea is always so delicious.
……さっきも言っていたけど。\nこのシンポジウム、まだ続けるの？: ...You mentioned it earlier too, but... are you really going to keep holding these symposiums?
ええ、可能な限り。\nできれば、最後の一人の不安を取り除けるまで。: Yes, as much as possible. If I can, until the anxieties of even the very last person are removed.
カークランドさんはどうしてここまでするのかしら？: Why do you go so far, Kirkland-san?
ここまで、といいますと？: What do you mean by 'so far'?
察するに、もうほとんどの貴族たちは、\n融和に賛成する立場なのよね。: From what I can tell, the vast majority of nobles are already in favor of reconciliation.
今日、シンポジウムに参加した貴族の人たちは、\n無視してしまっても、大きな影響は: The nobles who attended the symposium today... even if you ignored them, it wouldn't have a major impact, right?
今日のあの人のように……\n物理的な『力』で黙らせてしまうという手もある。: Just like that man today... you could also use physical 'force' to shut them up.
（権力がすげ替わる時には血が流れるもの……\nそれは私が知っている革命の歴史がそ: (When power shifts, blood is spilled... That's what the history of revolution I know has shown.)
カークランドさんが、危ない目にあって……\n心無い言葉をぶつけられてまですること: Isn't it going too far to endanger yourself and endure such heartless words, Kirkland-san?
……そうですね、ブレーメルさんの言う通りだと思います。: ...Yes, I think you are right, Bremer-san.
ですが、わたくしは……\nすべての人に納得していただいた上で進めたいのです。: However, I... wish to move forward only after securing everyone's understanding.
そうすることで、真の意味で貴族と平民は融和したと……\nノヴァセレスの民は一つに: By doing so, I believe we can say nobles and commoners have truly reconciled... and that the people of Novaceres have become one.
そして、それが……融和を推し進める貴族として……\nカークランド家の者としての責: And I am certain that... as a noble promoting reconciliation... and as a member of the Kirkland family, this is my duty.
（甘い、甘すぎる……夢のような話ね）: (Naive, far too naive... Like a fairytale dream.)
……お茶のおかわり、注ぐわね。: ...Let me pour you another cup of tea.
ありがとうございます。\n……ブレーメルさんはやっぱり優しいですね。: Thank you very much. ...Bremer-san, you really are so kind.
ふふっ、カークランドさんほどじゃないと思いますよ。: Fufu, I don't think I hold a candle to you, Kirkland-san.
……じゃなくて！\n怪我は大丈夫なんですか！？: ...Wait, no! Are you okay? Were you injured!?
昨日、シンポジウムで暴漢に襲われたって聞いて、\n慌ててきたんです！: I heard you were attacked by a thug at the symposium yesterday, so I rushed right over!
ああ、その話ですか。それなら未遂ですし、怪我はありませんよ。\n動きだした瞬間に: Ah, that matter. It was only an attempt, so I am completely unhurt. Bremer-san stopped him the moment he moved.
とりあえず、一旦落ち着きましょうか。\nお茶を持ってくるわ。: For now, why don't we calm down a bit? I'll bring some tea.
ありがとうございます。\n……あ、おいしい。なんだか、ほっとする感じがします。: Thank you very much. ...Ah, delicious. It feels somehow comforting.
ふふっ、よかったわ。\nリラックス効果がある茶葉で入れてみたの。: Fufu, I'm glad. I tried brewing it with tea leaves that have a relaxing effect.
……心配をかけて、ごめんなさいね。: ...I am sorry for making you worry.
いえ、先輩がずっと一人で危険なことをしていたっていうのにも\nちょっと怒っていま: No, I am a bit angry that you've been doing dangerous things all by yourself.
でも、一番は、こういった問題を知らず、\n興味を持っていなかった平民……: But most of all, I'm angry at the commoners who knew nothing about these issues and showed no interest...
シンポジウムは立場は関係なく、\n平民でも貴族でも、誰でも参加できるものですよね: The symposium is open to anyone regardless of status—commoners or nobles, anyone can join, right?
え、ええ……一応は、そういうことになっています。: Y-Yes... That is how it is structured, in principle.
それなのに、平民の参加は殆どいなかったって話じゃないですか。: Yet, from what I hear, hardly any commoners attended at all.
貴族の方々が、これからの生活に不満を訴えているのに、\n変化の恩恵を受ける側の平: While the nobles are voicing complaints about their future lives, the commoners who stand to benefit from the change aren't even showing interest...
ドロテア様のことですから、貴族の問題は貴族である自分がとか……: Knowing you, Dorothea-sama, you probably thought noble issues should be handled by a noble like yourself...
不平不満が飛び交う場に呼んで余計な心労をかけたくないとか、\n色々考えて、あえて: Or that you didn't want to burden others by inviting them to a place filled with grievances, so you deliberately didn't advertise it broadly...
今度から、私も絶対参加しますから！\n平民たちにも広く告知して、参加者を募ります: From now on, I will definitely participate too! I'll spread the word among commoners and recruit attendees.
うちのお母さんも張り切ってますし、結構大きく宣伝出来ると思います。: My mom is super fired up about it too, so I think we can advertise it quite widely.
はい。うちの母、記者をやっていますので。: Yes. My mom works as a reporter.
送られてきた告発文で記者魂を燃やされたみたいで、\n今、凄い勢いで記事を執筆して: It seems an anonymous tip sent to her ignited her reporter's spirit, and she's writing an article with incredible momentum right now.
はい。今朝がた、ポストに投函されてました。\n恥ずかしながら、この問題を私が知っ: Yes. It was dropped in our mailbox early this morning. Embarrassingly enough, I only learned about this issue thanks to that tip.
お母さんがいうには、どうやら主要な記者や雑誌社には\n同様の告発があったみたいで: According to mom, it seems major reporters and magazine publishers received similar tips.
あら、何かしら？\nお茶のお代わり？: My, what is it? Another refill of tea?
（全員が納得する平和な革命を目指し、\n立場の違う少女が真剣に話し合っている）: (Aiming for a peaceful revolution that satisfies everyone, young girls from different backgrounds are conversing seriously.)
（……こんな光景を、私は見たことはなかった）: (...I had never seen a sight like this before.)
（今回のよく分からない場所に飛ばされるという出来事は、\n私にとって、ちょっとし: (To me, this event of being whisked away to an unknown place is like a dream, a brief vacation.)
（でも……いえ、だからこそ、夢だというのであれば、\n夢のような甘い結末があって: (But... no, precisely because it is a dream, I think it's fine for it to have a sweet, dream-like ending.)
（そのために、私は協力しよう。\nこの優しすぎる貴族の少女へと――）: (For that sake, I shall offer my help. To this far too gentle noble girl—)
